definitions.complete_learning_route: At least one continuous resolved start-to-target path with no recorded upstream gap.
definitions.substantive_partial_route: No complete path; at least three sequential resolved transformations connect toward the exact target.
definitions.fragmentary_route: A source-supported exact-target graph resolves only one or two sequential transformations and retains an upstream gap.
definitions.candidate_only: Candidate source evidence exists, but no exact-identity route graph passes the public-alpha quality gate.
definitions.no_supporting_source_resolved: No supporting source was resolved within the recorded search scope; this is not a novelty or synthesizability claim.
